ops.body:
Speculative E2E follow-ups complete (Run wf_1af6fe16-486):
- cc-sync retention tie-break, cc-sync/retain-tiebreak @ e8ab89f:
  - Checkpoint gains Revision (the recording block revision); the order is CapturedAt desc, then Revision desc, then ID. Record returns ErrExpired only when actually expired and the new ErrSuperseded otherwise.
  - Tests failed first with the exact E2E symptom.
  - Wire note: Revision is required in the unreleased catalog v1 and there is no compat shim (per the no-intermediate-compat rule), so stale dev catalogs must be reset.
- D15 sparse E2E, cc-sync/e2e-sparse @ 2ae2afc:
  - TestPickupSparseSourceUnavailable (cone and non-cone). Default pickup reports the honest expansion (Exact=false, one named difference, sparse block expanded:true, out-of-cone files present). --apply-sparse on a fresh destination gives Exact=true, a matching sparse list and out-of-cone files absent. WIP is byte-identical in both.
  - It found and fixed a real E2E-harness bug: the restorer dropped ApplySparse/Restored.Sparse, which would have made --apply-sparse a silent no-op in the suite. The lane confirmed the test catches that bug by reverting the passthrough.
- synckit harness WaitIdle atomicity, cc-sync/synckit-harness-waitidle @ 3508fb8:
  - Reproduced 20/20 before the fix. deliveryScheduler.settledStatus reads the record, the live state and settled under one lane lock.
All three merge in phase 2c (the prep lane Run wf_cc6c0bd3-9bb is already merging e2e + sparse + tiebreak on cc-sync/phase2c). The synckit harness + WaitIdle fix join the synckit final after its fix and refutation.
